disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of Cd, Fe, Hg, Cr, Ni and Zn in nine leafy and non-leafy vegetables from one urban farm irrigated with groundwater and a municipal-waste-dominated stream, on a fresh-weight basis.

study.design: Single urban farm study: soils, irrigation water and nine vegetables from nine beds
study.origin: urban vegetable farm about 2 km from Takoradi market, Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolis, Western Region, Ghana
study.method: Acid digestion of freeze-dried edible parts; Hg by cold-vapour AAS and other metals by flame AAS (Agilent 240FS); results expressed on fresh weight
study.qa: NIST SRMs listed (1570a spinach leaves, 1646a, 1643e); spike recoveries 70-102%; RSD < 10%
